text:
maria: quick sync — i'm preparing the docs changelog for tomorrow's push. items: fallback routing example, streaming-embeddings truncation for big payloads, one broken redirect, and a few tiny SDK example fixes. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4301

sam: sounds good. can we make the whatsnew box machine-friendly (short bullets, no marketing), so partners can parse it programmatically?

maria: yes — i'll use three terse bullets and include explicit links. keep it technical.

chris: i fixed a small typo in the rust example (iterator -> next_message) and added a comment about verifying stop tokens with quantized fallbacks. pushed to PR.

lee: found a 404: /docs/dedicated/autoscale -> 404. filed PR #4302 to add a temporary 301 to /docs/dedicated/scaling.

jen: added a compact node snippet for fallback routing sized for the whatsnew column. will paste it in the PR.

maria: paste node snippet here please, jen, so i can sanity-check formatting.

jen: ```js
// minimal fallback routing
import Redwood from '@redwood/inference'
const client = new Redwood(process.env.REDWOOD_API_KEY)
const res = await client.generate({
  model: 'redwood-kitefish-v1',
  fallbacks: ['redwood-kitefish-v1-quant','gpt-compatible-fallback']
})
console.log(res.text)
```

sam: add a parenthetical after the snippet: (Note: quantized fallback may tokenize differently; verify prompt and stop tokens).

maria: will add. also adding link to quantization guide and migration steps.

chris: for the changelog bullets i suggest: 1) Added fallback routing example + snippet (link), 2) Known issue: streaming embeddings may truncate on payloads >4MB — workaround linked, 3) Docs: SDK example fixes across rust/go/node. super short lines.

lee: agree. i'll reference the redirect PR under Known issues as "docs redirect in progress".

docs-bot: reminder — staging deploy scheduled for tomorrow 09:00 UTC after signoff.

sam: i'll run a local build after maria updates PR. aiming for LGTM by 07:00 UTC.

maria: thanks all — i'll update the PR now, request formal LGTM, and ping when staging is live. :rocket:
